palette_guide.how_to_edit: Change the #RRGGBB values in palette below. These descriptions are notes, not color values. Reopen the app or select UI > Reload current UI after saving.
palette_guide.saved_settings: Appearance > Text colors can override text and menu_text. Click Restore text colors there to use this JSON's values again.
palette_guide.sidebar: Project/chat sidebar and settings window background.
palette_guide.rail: Top bar behind File/Edit/View/Help and the left navigation rail.
palette_guide.surface: Composer, popup surfaces, and many hover backgrounds.
palette_guide.input_background: Text box background in Codex and Gemini. Separate from other surfaces.
palette_guide.text: GENERAL TEXT: main labels, conversation text, headings, and chat titles. Keep this bright for readability.
palette_guide.menu_text: TOP ROW TEXT: File, Edit, View, Help, and the UI selector. Independent of general text; gray matches the original app.
palette_guide.muted: Secondary text, descriptions, placeholder labels, and many idle icons. Independent of the top row text.
palette_guide.accent: Theme accent for highlighted controls, such as the interface scale slider.
